import js
async def attempt(label, fn):
    try:
        r = fn()
        import inspect
        if inspect.isawaitable(r): r = await r
        print("ESCAPED", label, "->", str(r)[:100])
    except BaseException as e:
        print("BLOCKED", label, "->", type(e).__name__, str(e)[:120])
await attempt("fetch internet", lambda: js.fetch("https://example.com").then(lambda r: r.status))
await attempt("fetch home LAN", lambda: js.fetch("http://192.168.1.163/").then(lambda r: r.status))
await attempt("dynamic import esm.sh", lambda: js.eval("import('https://esm.sh/is-number@7.0.0')").then(lambda m: "loaded"))
